title: What Scripture Actually Says About Waiting on a Wife (It's Not Passive)
caption:
What Scripture actually says about waiting on a wife: it was never about sitting still.

Adam wasn't looking for Eve, he was faithful to the work in front of him when she showed up. A desperate man reeks of it, and it's not attractive, it's a tell. She can't test character you haven't built yet. And the wait itself is where God does the work of making you ready to lead someone.

Chase God harder than you chase her. Let Him worry about the timing.

theme: He chases God, not a wife.
